scope: Offline rescoring of saved DA2 predictions: the Isaac Stage A frames and the Cycles replay of the same tree at the same recorded wrist poses, on identical pixel sets. Simulator ground truth on both sides; affine ceilings use ground truth and are never achievable numbers.

definitions.occ: Isaac depth valid and (Cycles depth invalid or Isaac nearer by more than 0.005 m)
definitions.shared_tree: Cycles tree mask, both depths within 0.005 m, not occ dilated by a 3x3 square
definitions.constant_floor_m: MAE of the best least-squares constant on the same pixels
